svg.text: What this record's own numbers can and cannot support
The graded oracle is cctbx grading cctbx
The T03 rows carrying verdicts use phenix.model_vs_data with oracle_family cctbx, against a PHENIX
refinement. CLAUDE.md forbids this as a sole basis. gemmi is the only cross-family path here and is
recorded as corroborative, so the cctbx verdicts are provisional.
Raw oracle output was not retained
Only the typed measurement rows were committed, so 0.1564 / 0.2116 cannot be re-derived from this
repository without a licensed PHENIX rerun.
qds_emit.py does not propagate pass_status, so no status in this record reaches the sheet, and its
headline R-factors are the gemmi triple. Read verdicts from the eval, not the sheet.
The trust invariant passes by omission
The sheet carries no open cctbx-only row because it does not grade T06 — the row open on every prior 1SAR
sheet. Nothing that was open was closed.
